gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-sintony: Wallpoet storms in with high-rising lowercase and gaps where the paper shows between letters. And Sintony follows with a chunky, tall midzone and curves that stay smooth and unclogged.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-sono: Warnes stretches out, its ink strokes tapering away before they touch.
gen-irish-grover-gf-stack-sans-headline: Fun and organic, Irish Grover makes its tall lowercase look sturdy.
gen-megrim-gf-stack-sans-notch: Stack Sans Notch has open curves you can see right into, each stroke cut like rod stock. But Megrim, thin and angular up top, is what gives the pair its futuristic edge.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-puritan: Puritan is all rounded forms and oversized, open e and a counters.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-pt-sans-caption: Goldman spaces its round, parenthesis-like letters far apart.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-questrial: Chunky, upbeat, and plainly built, Grandstander holds its letters open rather than curled shut, with a tall x-height under short ascenders.
gen-mystery-quest-fs-bespoke-sans: Storybook charm, with open jaws on every curve and compact ascenders over tall lowercase.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-abeezee: Mystery Quest wears a bookish, nostalgic face, its curves opening like jaws.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-aldrich: Old-library mood, with open jaws on every curve.
